about: Born by a jump (Projectile_Jump) and many other moves; up to 2 holders. Written by esv::safe_position::TrackingSystem.

evidence.says: EoCServer.dll esv::safe_position::TrackingSystem::ProcessNotSafePositionChanges iterates the event storage with stride 0x18, takes the EntityHandle at +0 and looks up that character's esv::SafePositionComponent; the event entity itself is destroyed. Live: entity-handle shaped values.
Same function compares +8/+0xC/+0x10 with the SafePositionComponent's position and copies them into it. Live floats (world coordinates).
